publicSafety: Public status URLs, source-post dates, author handles, record types, posted-link metadata, mention handles, hashtags, classifications, and dated aggregate counts only; post text, phone numbers, cookies, private account state, and session data are excluded.

populationReconciliation.conclusion: The authenticated public surfaces yielded and this pass reviewed 3,123 unique records, or 60.9% of the 5,124-post profile counter. The remaining 2,001 profile-counted records are not represented as absent or deleted: X's documented display limits make the owner archive necessary for literal 100% recovery.
populationReconciliation.dateBoundary: For originals and replies, sourcePublishedAt is the coalition-account post date. For native reposts, X exposes the source post's timestamp, not the date @NYCArtC reposted it; source-post years must not be presented as account-activity years.

recurringFunctions: campaign calls to action and hearing mobilization
publishingPattern.recordTypeMethod: recordType partitions the 3,123 unique source-status URLs: account-authored source statuses are original or reply, while external source statuses surfaced through native repost cards are repost. Two account-authored quote-post URLs also appeared as native self-repost cards; their source-status identity remains original and the nonexclusive appearance is retained separately.
publishingPattern.classificationMethod: Mission signals are deterministic matches against public post text, hashtags, and displayed link destinations. Raw text is intentionally excluded; the rule manifest and first matched public-safe phrase are retained per classified row so the label can be replayed. Signals can overlap and describe subject matter, not authorship, endorsement, causality, or impact.

missionSignalClassification.matchPolicy: A record receives a signal when at least one input matches the rule. The fixture retains the first matched value and input field for each assigned signal while excluding the surrounding post text.
missionSignalClassification.boundary: Signal matches support corpus subject classification only. They do not establish who authored a post, whether a source account engaged, campaign endorsement, policy causality, participation, reach, or impact.

sourceAuthorNetwork.boundary: The unique-URL population contains 685 @NYCArtC-authored source statuses and 2,438 external source statuses surfaced through native repost cards. Two of the account-authored quote-post URLs also appeared as native self-repost cards, so source-status identity and timeline appearance are recorded as separate axes. Appearance in this network does not by itself establish that the source account engaged with the coalition, endorsed a campaign, collaborated with Jamie, or authorized the repost.

hashtagInventory.boundary: Hashtags are public publishing signals. Counts can overlap and are not measures of campaign reach, participation, or outcomes.
